snippet.title: Dead by Daylight : Sinister Grace - Animated Trailer | Galaxies Autumn 2025 Showcase
snippet.description:
Witness the stage set for horror in Dead by Daylight: Sinister Grace. Enter the fog of Thai folklore where a performer’s ambition birthed a monstrous legend. The new Killer, The Krasue, shifts between a graceful body and a floating, entrail-draped head with deadly speed and horrifying power. The new Survivor, Vee Boonyasak, a drumming rock-star turned escape artist, brings rhythm and grit to the Trial. With new Perks, a haunting atmosphere, and the Fog changed forever, this chapter is ready to claim its victims. Coming soon in Chapter 37: Sinister Grace.

Dead by Daylight was the exclusive Twitch Drops partner for Galaxies Autumn Showcase 2025.
